messages:
emma: FYI I'm trying to land docs PR #842 (SDK migration guide + snippet) before the 03/26 release cutoff. Needs reviews and a docs-preview green. Can reviewers pile on? @sanjay @maria @kai
sanjay: happy to review in a bit, what blocking items? is there a feature flag needed?
emma: no new FF. It's doc-only plus a tiny SDK code sample under `docs/sdk/migration.md` that shows `client.chat.create({model: "redwood/fast"})`.
kai: quick note — example imports differ from latest SDK. I'll push a one-line fix to match the v2 snippet style.
maria: timeline: cutoff is 03/26 18:00 PT per release calendar, but eng wants merges 2h earlier to run canary. So target 16:00 PT. Can we get CI green before then?
emma: ok aiming for 15:30 PT to have buffer. assigning reviewers: @sanjay (API), @kai (snippets). @maria @docs-bot FYI.
sanjay: found a small nit: in migration.md there's `timeout: 3000` but should be `timeout_ms` in v2 examples. i'll leave a review comment.
kai: pushed commit `fix/snippet-imports` -> updated imports and example usage. also fixed a broken link to `quickstart.md` (was ./quickstart -> ../quickstart)
ci-bot: docs-preview build queued for PR #842 — build 37294
ci-bot: docs-preview build 37294 — ✅ passed (render ok, broken links: 0)
docs-bot: added tag `docs/ready-to-merge` on PR #842
emma: thanks! @sanjay can you recheck after commit? small nit only.
sanjay: rechecked, LGTM. approving now :thumbsup:
maria: note — feature-flag rollout for the runtime change lands 03/25 23:00 PT; docs talk about optional param for that change. we should mark the section as 'effective 03/25' to avoid confusion.
emma: will add a short banner in migration.md: `Note: applies after 2026-03-25 release`
kai: also added a tiny test snippet under `examples/migration_test.py` to ensure code sample runs.
emma: CI still green; planning to merge at 15:45 PT. Who will press the button during the canary window?
maria: i'll do the merge and will coordinate canary smoke tests with infra.
sanjay: thanks. quick merge command if needed: `gh pr merge 842 --squash --delete-branch`
emma: done — merged at 1820000539 (approx 15:45 PT). :shipit: 
maria: starting canary verification now.
ci-bot: canary-smoke build 4721 — all checks passed
maria: canary good. marking docs release note slot as filled.
emma: closing thread — thanks all :tada:
